name: Diagnostic: FDM on/off switch
description: Measurement only. Starts with the game's fragment density map off (as with vr_fdm 0) while the game runs with +vr_fdm 1; `guest_patch disable alyx_etfr_fdm_ab` turns it on and `enable` off again, for same-session A/B.

sites.name: fdm_request
sites.evidence: renderingpipelines.dll 0x1786C (reverse_study 2026-10-16): the only call to the FDM create/lookup function 0x16C70, in the VR pipeline builder 0x171C0 ("Static Opaque Forward", "Translucent Forward"); rcx = rbp+0F0h (out), edx/r8d = RT size, r9d = layers; followed by mov rax,[rax]. 0x16C70 stores 0 in *out and returns out when vr_fdm is 0 or the device has no FDM.
